title: Replying to @ramkoff final show from the trip, and an absolute hidden...
transcript: nobody asked me specifically for this show but I absolutely loved Where the Mountain Meets the Sea and I'm sad that more people aren't talking about it I know I said this before on here this year but most of my favorite shows that I've seen this year have been off Broadway where the Mountain Meets the Sea is definitely one of those show is about a father and son both going on different journeys in their lives both figuratively and literally there is music in this written and performed by the Bengsons who have written a couple shows most notably Hundred Days which is a criminally underrated cast recording if you haven't listened to it I don't know if I would classify this as a musical but I think the music plays more of a part narratively that it would in a play with music so it's more like a non traditional musical because this is almost like intertwining one man shows that occasionally there's music for it takes a little while to get into it but the payoff is totally worth it the performances were spectacular the songs were amazing the show closes Sunday the 27th so you only have a week to go see it but if you are in New York please go watch it
